title: Temporal Design Automated Gate Result
description: Machine-readable result of the automated (non-interactive) design gate path of the temporal-design skill. See references/automated-gate.md. A score is only comparable to another score produced under the same schema_version and corpus_version. List assertions and hard_fail results most-severe first.

subject.description: What was scored: design id, workflow name, or commit sha.

schema_version.description: Immutable criteria-schema version the score is under.

corpus_version.description: Pinned replay-history corpus version used by the replay runner.

level.description: design = whole design; workflow = a single authored workflow.

gate.description: inconclusive = a required input was missing; the gate fails closed.

weighted_score.description: Weighted combination of deterministic (pass=1) and model-graded (score/5) assertions.

threshold.description: Minimum weighted_score to pass, from the criteria schema.

hard_fail.description: Result of each hard-fail invariant. Any failed invariant forces gate: fail.

evidence.description: Optional pointer to the failing history, payload, branch, or primitive.

assertions.description: Each deterministic and model-graded assertion result, most-severe (failing, highest weight) first.

passed.description: For model_graded, true when median score meets the assertion's pass bar.

score.description: Model-graded only: median score across trials.

trials.description: Model-graded only: number of judge trials.

variance.description: Model-graded only: score variance across trials.

evidence.description: Evidence-before-score text (model-graded) or a file/line pointer (deterministic).

source.description: Rubric/checklist section this assertion compiles from.

baseline_ref.description: Design/commit the candidate was compared against.

noise_band.description: A drop within this band is not treated as a regression.

inconclusive_reason.description: Set when gate is inconclusive: which required input was missing.
